name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1829: The chronicle and vault readers crop before reading and retry the full frame when the crop is refused - but the retry fired only when the crop returned NOTHING. A crop answering stateVisible:false is truthy, so the retry never ran, and that is the common case because what a crop cuts away is the chrome the reader is judging. One sets page was recorded no-found-state twice while both lanes read the full frame at conf 0.90 and 0.88 with five dated pieces.
